decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends the firm's established two-component platform, so keeping it on the market costs little, and its corrosion-protection prospects are still uncertain enough to keep the option open.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own page and a documented field test on a construction site, which shows the option is being exercised rather than showing evidence for abandonment.
The transfer pump line builds on the proven air motors, so it shares components and costs little to maintain, and its several models give the firm flexible options.
Fire protection flow monitoring is a more distant digital add-on, but it fits the firm's digitalization strategy, still has its own page, and its value is not yet resolved, so the option stays open.
The hydraulic two-component system was launched only in 2024 and sits close to the core offer, so its uncertainty is high and holding it costs little, which favors keeping it.
